responsibility: Builds explanatory lifetime-region subdiagnostics by translating internal region kinds into human-readable descriptions, source spans, and fluent message variants, then attaches those explanations as notes for inference and borrow-checking style error reports.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `error_reporting/infer/note_and_explain.rs`, which augments specific mismatch diagnostics with case-based notes and suggestions, this file is dedicated to reusable lifetime-region explanation data. It turns region kinds into `RegionExplanation` subdiagnostics with message variants, spans, and wording prefixes/suffixes, for attachment by other reporters rather than interpreting `TypeError` cases itself.
